open_points.subject: A04 TrialCase expected outputs matching
open_points.text: "expected outputs, when present, fit the output ports"; "A case passes when the execution succeeded and, if the case states expected outputs, every output's digest equals the expected one"
open_points.question: When `expected_outputs` is present on an authored trial case, must it include exactly all output ports (no missing, no extra), or may it be a subset?
options: Require exactly one expected value per declared output port; extra or missing ports are refused.
Allow a subset of output ports; only listed ports are compared at admission.
Allow missing ports but refuse unknown extra ports.
open_points.default_guess: Require exact coverage of all output ports when `expected_outputs` is present.

open_points.subject: A13 mapped-element re-execution after prior attempts
open_points.text: "runs every one that has no concluded record and does not wait" (A13 rule 2) vs retries/resends that must happen after prior records (A11 rule 3 `not_applied` -> next send; A14 rule 2 resume resends `service_unreachable`).
open_points.question: What is the executable condition for an element that already has one or more NodeExecution records but must be attempted again?
options: Use element conclusion state (from NodeExecution + EffectAttempt), not mere existence of a concluded record.
Interpret "no concluded record" as "no concluded record for the next required attempt".
Keep literal meaning and add a separate retry path that bypasses rule 2.
open_points.default_guess: Drive execution by current element conclusion state, allowing new attempts after `service_unreachable` resume and after `not_applied` re-approval.

open_points.subject: A13 run response while resting
open_points.text: "A run that rests returns the outputs produced so far; the per-output reasons below are given only once it has ended."
open_points.question: For non-ended runs, how are not-yet-produced flow outputs represented in the returned run result?
options: Return only produced outputs; omit all others until end.
Return all outputs, with explicit interim markers for not-yet-produced ones.
Return produced outputs plus a separate list of pending output port names.
open_points.default_guess: Return only produced outputs and omit missing outputs until the run ends.

open_points.subject: A07 personal-data redaction for TrialExecution/NodeExecution references
open_points.text: "An agent never receives a `personal_data` value ... it returns only the value's digest and class ... and no `value_id`. The same holds for a `personal_data` file" while M23/M07 records are defined as references by `value_id` / spooled-file facts.
open_points.question: When a mixed execution record contains both open and personal-data inputs/outputs, does the agent receive the full record with selective field replacement, or are referenced entries removed entirely per-port/per-item?
options: Selective replacement in-place per value/file item (keep record structure, replace sensitive items with digest+class only).
Drop sensitive ports/items entirely from agent view.
Return two parallel sections (visible items and redacted summaries).
open_points.default_guess: Keep record structure and replace each personal-data item in-place with digest+class only.
